examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The "See how to use" band of a product page: the title at the start of the row, the previous and next controls at its end, and six cards in a track that scrolls past the row. Each card is an overline, a heading, a sentence and a mono "See example" label; the heading is the link and the whole card is its hit area, so hovering anywhere nudges the arrow.

examples.name: Plain cards
examples.summary: Industries with no overline and no link: each card is a heading and a sentence, with no hover state and no link label. The band takes an eyebrow above its own title.
